name: Arrowhead Resort
description: Family- and veteran-owned Illinois River outfitter on OK-10 north of Tahlequah, at GRDA river mile 32.5. Rents rafts and single or tandem kayaks for short and long floats. Cabins, full-hookup RV sites, an electric and non-electric main campground, and riverside primitive tent sites.

name: Eagle Bluff Resort
description: Illinois River campground and outfitter on OK-10 north of Tahlequah, at GRDA river mile 36.1. Runs half-day and full-day raft and kayak floats and half-day tube floats, with shuttle. Primitive and electric campgrounds, full-hookup RV sites, cabins, glamping tents, hot showers, a camp store and a weekend restaurant.

name: Peyton's Place Resort
description: Long-running canoe camp on OK-10 north of Tahlequah, at GRDA river mile 36.8. Rents canoes, rafts and kayaks for floats of about 6 or 11 miles, with the shuttle included in the rate. Cabins, an apartment, a group bunkhouse, a 19-space full-hookup RV park, electric and primitive campsites, a shower house and a camp store.

name: War Eagle Resort
description: Large Illinois River outfitter on OK-10 north of Tahlequah, at GRDA river mile 39.8. Runs short and long raft and kayak floats. Cabins, bunkhouses and motel rooms, first-come primitive tent camping, electric and water RV sites along the river, and a store at the main office. Book by phone or email.
seasonal_notes: Camping is for guests floating with War Eagle: every stay requires at least one float trip.

name: Diamondhead Resort
description: Illinois River outfitter on OK-10 about 5 miles north of Tahlequah, at GRDA river mile 40.0. First-come raft and single or tandem kayak floats from Edmondson Access (Combs Bridge) or Peavine Hollow, with shuttle. Motel rooms, cabins, bunkhouses, first-come primitive tent camping, water/electric and full-hookup RV sites, and hot showers.

name: Illinois River Outfitters
description: Illinois River outfitter on OK-10 north of Tahlequah, at GRDA river mile 40.0, open since 2018. Raft and sit-on-top kayak floats from Peavine Hollow (long trip) or Edmondson Access (short trip) to its landing. Shuttles private boats from Edmondson, Peavine Hollow, Round Hollow or Chewey Bridge to its landing. Log A-frame cabins, RV hookups and primitive tent camping.

name: Riverbend Floats
description: Illinois River outfitter near the OK-10 / US-62 junction at Tahlequah, at GRDA river mile 55.0. Rents rafts, kayaks, tubes and cooler tubes. Floaters ride a bus upriver to its private launch and float back to the base. Lodging in three cabin-style rentals on OK-10.

name: Riverside Camp
description: Illinois River outfitter and campground on OK-10 north of Tahlequah, at GRDA river mile 27.5 near Round Hollow Access. Rents rafts, canoes and kayaks. Cabins, a group lodge, electric and primitive campsites, and a camp store.

name: Highwater Camp
description: Small self-service campground on a gravel bar of the upper Illinois River near Watts, at GRDA river mile 11.8 above the Flint Creek confluence. One large primitive riverside site and two electric RV/tent sites, booked online only. No boat rentals or shuttle. Non-campers can buy a River Access Pass to launch or take out private boats. The gravel bar floods in high water.
seasonal_notes: Open May 1 to November 15. Online booking only; no drop-ins.

name: Echota Village RV Park
description: RV park and campground on the Illinois River off OK-10 north of Tahlequah, run by the United Keetoowah Band of Cherokee Indians Corporate Board. 16 RV sites with water, electric and sewer, a primitive tent area with rentable bell tents, a rental cabin and a convenience store.
seasonal_notes: RV and tent camping is available year-round.
